Westwood Plateau, Coquitlam: 48 condos and townhomes listed at the end of October 2026 and 6 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 13%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 4 of 23 Coquitlam communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Westwood Plateau fell from 53 in June to 48 in October (−9.4%), and 41 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 6.2% of Coquitlam’s 779 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Westwood Plateau?
Westwood Plateau also had 57 houses listed and 8 sold in October, against 48 condos and townhomes listed. The Westwood Plateau houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Westwood Plateau Condos and Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: What is verifiable on a City source is the setting those complexes sit: the City's trail guide maps Westwood Plateau Trails, the Westwood Plateau Golf Academy trail and the Plateau Boulevard and Panorama Drive street pattern the strata complexes front.

Rental and pet bylaws are per-strata here and are not published on a municipal page; for any Plateau Boulevard or Dayanee Springs unit they come from the Form B and the strata's own bylaws, not from a neighbourhood source.

blocks.text: Westwood Plateau Condos and Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Slope and interface rules are the Plateau-specific overlay: the City's Schedule B Environmental Development Permit Areas map maps unstable slopes and the Interface Wildfire Risk Management boundary for the City Centre and Northeast areas, and a townhouse backing onto an Eagle Mountain greenbelt is the unit to check against those layers.

blocks.text: Westwood Plateau Condos and Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Westwood Plateau Village at Parkway Boulevard and Johnson Street is the in-neighbourhood shopping node the City profile names, separate from Coquitlam Centre down the hill on Barnet Highway.

The City trail guide maps a named loop on the Plateau streets — the Westwood Plateau Trails and the Golf Academy trail around Plateau Boulevard, Panorama Drive and Johnson Street — which is the trail network directly behind many strata complexes.

Panorama Heights Elementary at 1455 Johnson Street and Bramblewood Elementary at 2875 Panorama Drive put two elementary schools on the Plateau itself, which is not true of every Coquitlam bench neighbourhood.
The profile's figures are from Census Canada 2016 as printed in the 2019 profile — check current before quoting the 19,775 population or the 64% postsecondary figure from that document.

blocks.text: Westwood Plateau Condos and Townhomes: costs and taxes

items.t: No municipal page states strata fees, contingency amounts or special levies for any Westwood Plateau complex, so those figures come only from the unit's Form B and strata documents.

blocks.text: Westwood Plateau Condos and Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check the Interface Wildfire Risk Management boundary and unstable-slope layers on the City's Schedule B Environmental Development Permit Areas map for any complex backing onto Eagle Mountain greenbelt; the map shows the layers, not a lot-level conclusion.

Check watercourse setbacks for complexes near the Plateau's creek corridors under the Watercourse Protection Development Permit rules: within 30 metres of top of bank or ravine bank in the plan area, land alteration needs that permit.
Check the strata's depreciation report for envelope and roof condition on 1990s–2000s low-rise complexes; no municipal page publishes building condition for a Plateau complex.

blocks.text: Westwood Plateau home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

44 condos sold in Westwood Plateau with a median price of $656,500 (the middle half sold between $617,500 and $715,575), taking a median of 24 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 2% sold above list. They had a median $689 per square foot, a median year built of 2008 and a median strata fee of $487 a month. 33 townhomes sold in Westwood Plateau with a median price of $1,132,500 (the middle half sold between $995,000 and $1,200,000), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $508 per square foot, a median year built of 1998 and a median strata fee of $508 a month.

faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 48 condos and townhomes listed in Westwood Plateau. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Westwood Plateau?

faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Westwood Plateau had a sales ratio of 13%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
faq.q: Is Westwood Plateau a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?

faq.a: 41 condos and townhomes sold in Westwood Plateau over those 5 months, out of 596 in all of Coquitlam.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Westwood Plateau from June to October 2026?

faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?

faq.a: A townhouse and house area. A buyer who wants a concrete high-rise is shopping City Centre or Burquitlam; a buyer here is choosing among low-rise strata complexes and houses.
faq.q: Is Westwood Plateau a tower area or a townhouse area?

faq.a: The Plateau schools named in School District No. 43 (Coquitlam) (SD43) listings include Panorama Heights Elementary at 1455 Johnson Street and Bramblewood Elementary at 2875 Panorama Drive.
faq.q: Which schools sit on the Plateau itself?

faq.a: No station is on the Plateau. The TransLink route that serves the townhouse streets is route 187, Coquitlam Central Station to Parkway, which runs Johnson Street, Plateau Boulevard and Paddock Drive to Parkway Boulevard — a bus ride down the hill to Coquitlam Central Station, which is served by the Millennium Line Evergreen Extension and the West Coast Express.
faq.q: Is there a SkyTrain station for these townhouses?

faq.a: Golf and trails, per the City profile. The profile states green space abounds in Westwood Plateau, from neighbourhood parks to an extensive trail system that links to the backcountry trails on Eagle Mountain, and two golf courses; the City trail guide also maps the Westwood Plateau Golf Academy trail. That is the amenity base a townhouse buyer here uses daily, rather than the City Centre facilities.
faq.q: What recreation is inside the neighbourhood, not down the hill?
What did condos in Westwood Plateau sell for?
faq.a: 44 condos sold in Westwood Plateau between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $656,500.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Westwood Plateau?
faq.a: The median was 24 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.4% of the last list price (2% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
